```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
penguins %>%
  drop_na() %>% # Ensure there are no missing values
  ggplot(aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
             y = bill_depth_mm, 
             color = species, 
             size = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Palmer Penguins: Bill Dimensions",
    subtitle = "Analysis of bill length, depth, and body mass by species",
    x = "Bill Length (mm)",
    y = "Bill Depth (mm)",
    color = "Species",
    size = "Body Mass (g)"
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma") # Using a beautiful color palette
```
